events.text: Roger Barry recommenced his observations after the 1806 war.
events.subject: part_of_self
events.quote: After the 1806 war over the Grand Duchy of Badens claims to areas of the Palatinate and thus the observatory , the Court Astronomer , Roger Barry , recommenced his observations

events.text: Roger Barry died, until which the observatory remained unused.
events.subject: part_of_self
events.quote: the observatory remained unused until his death in 1813
